supersession_reason: Option A. mu=1.0 was derived and confirmed on CLASS-level gauge readings (~1.0) but its feature space was the 115 per-cell SEPARATION A-scores (~0.56 healthy, discriminative markers) -> z ~ -22 for every healthy cell. This reference scores the 8 CLASS GAUGE readings (identity loci, cpg_gauge_engine) against the AGE-MATCHED band from age_reference_matrix. DERIVED-IAMAtlas-ONLY preserved (no GEO, no pooled cohort); age matters (the whole-session correction).
sigma_source: age_reference_matrix -> (A_mean - A_p10)/1.2816 per class per age
covariance_note: Diagonal Sigma. Distance = sqrt( sum_c ((A_c - mu_c(age))/sigma_c(age))^2 ) over assessable classes. Off-diagonal cross-class correlations are population-empirical and deliberately NOT used (would reintroduce a cohort).
assessable_gating: Distance summed ONLY over classes the Stage-2 presence gate marks assessable in the patient's substrate (A not None). Whole blood: immune (+ any tissue class shed into cfDNA). Non-assessable classes are EXCLUDED, not imputed.
provenance: No GEO. No pooled cohort. Derived from IAMAtlas H_min floors + age_reference_matrix (EDEAR, 8 classes x 10 age bins).
calibration_note: Under the age-matched healthy band, distance^2 = sum z^2 ~ chi^2(n_assessable); alarm threshold sqrt(chi2.ppf(p, n_assessable)) at p95/p99, n-adaptive. A healthy patient sits at its age band -> z ~ 0 per class -> small distance.
